metadata.purpose: Reschedule all source notifications, including completion and errors, with independently owned scheduler tasks.

conditions: Every source next becomes exactly one scheduled next unless cancelled first.
Source complete and source error are both scheduled notifications, never immediate result signals.
FIFO scheduler tie order preserves input order at equal deadlines; consumer cancellation releases every queued action.

scope.parameters: Virtual FIFO scheduler supplied externally; nonnegative safe integer delay 2.
scope.callbacks: No user projection callbacks; opaque source values and error identities remain unchanged.
scope.time: Source arrival and scheduler.fire times are inputs. Due time is arrival+delay, and only a legal head-of-queue timer can fire.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic nonreentrant delivery. Scheduler callbacks do not reenter current transitions.
exclusions: Custom or non-FIFO schedulers; negative/nonintegral/overflow delay, synchronous recursive SchedulerActions.
Downstream observer reentrancy and throwing teardown; source acquisition may not synchronously deliver reentrant events.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe source immediately; reschedule its notifications independently.

ownership.sharing: None; each consumer gets fresh source and scheduled-action subscriptions.
ownership.reset: New queue and token counter per subscription; cancellation clears queued actions.

resources.owner: result subscriber until fire or cancel

dispatch.actionSemantics: Queue arrival in stable order. Emit downstream only when scheduler returns the matching token at or after its deadline.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between source arrivals and queued timer actions.

controls.description: source may be live and queued notifications await scheduler
